CustomField.description: The ledger Ramp activity posts to. Holds the ledger's unique External Id (AcctSeed__ExtId__c) — preferred, since it is unique and survives renames. A ledger Name is also accepted for first-run/back-compat; on resolution the Name is stamped into the ledger's blank External Id so later lookups use the unique key.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the ledger's External Id (preferred) or its Name. Defaults to "Actual".
CustomField.label: Default Ledger
